chunks.arabic_text: وَسَأَلَ عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ عُتْبَةَ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ:

translations.en: ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿUtbah asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:

chunks.arabic_text: عَمَّا يَصِلُ إِلَيْنَا مِنْ ثِيَابِ الْكَعْبَةِ هَلْ يَصْلُحُ لَنَا أَنْ نَلْبَسَ شَيْئًا مِنْهَا

translations.en: about what reaches us of the garments of the Kaʿbah: is it suitable for us to wear anything from it?

chunks.arabic_text: فَقَالَ «يَصْلُحُ لِلصِّبْيَانِ وَالْمَصَاحِفِ وَالْمِخَدَّةِ تَبْتَغِي بِذَلِكَ الْبَرَكَةَ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى».

translations.en: So he said: “It is suitable for children, for the masahif, and for the cushion; seeking blessing through that, if Allah, the Exalted, wills.”

en.summary: This hadith addresses the use of cloth from the coverings of the Kaʿbah. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that such cloth is suitable for children, masahif, and cushions, with the intention of seeking barakah by it, indicating a permissibility tied to respectful use.
en.seo_question: Is it permissible to use or wear cloth from the covering of the Kaʿbah?

key_terms.ثِيَابِ الْكَعْبَةِ: the cloths or coverings of the Kaʿbah
key_terms.الْبَرَكَةَ: blessing sought through a sacred association
